FN-GGBA2C2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 389
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Shane Stringer
Security
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/08/2024
House Bill 389 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund by $10,000 per
violation for any civil penalties levied for violation of the Second Amendment Financial Privacy
Act.
This bill could also increase receipts to the Attorney General's Litigation Support Fund by an
undetermined amount depending on the amount of attorney's fees and other reasonable court
costs recovered from such civil action.
